knownFailures.step: two open editors keep syncing across a hibernation
knownFailures.note: WebSocket hibernation is not available on Rivet 3. Orange emulates it: it drops the idle object and keeps its sockets open, but the Rivet actor does not sleep while a socket is open. This step waits for every actor to sleep, so it fails with: Some actor was still awake. Under the emulated sleep gate it also fails: the room does not hibernate while the two editors are connected.
